title: Successive determinantal ideals are decreasing
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let ι and κ be finite types, let P be an ι-by-κ matrix over R, and let d be a natural number. Define D_a(P) as the ideal generated by determinants of submatrices selected by embeddings Fin a into the row and column sets. Then D_(d+1)(P) is contained in D_d(P), including d=0 and unavailable sizes.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (P : Matrix ι κ R) (d : ℕ), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (d + 1) ↪ ι) (cols : Fin (d + 1) ↪ κ), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}) ≤ Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ ι) (cols : Fin d ↪ κ), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}
